title: Make MÖRK the shared default tank
context: The owner requested MÖRK as the default in every tank context after still seeing MK-CX/2 at game startup and in the Beam lab.
outcome: A shared content default selects MÖRK in the game, spare hull bays, Beam lab, astronaut scale reference, material lab and tank cinematics. Units opens on MÖRK unless explicitly selecting another subject/group. The old models remain explicit legacy selections. Bay casting waits for MÖRK as well as the container asset. Beam uses the authored plasma muzzle sockets without the legacy inferred barrel-tip offset. Game rules and shell cooldown heat feedback are unchanged.
alternatives: Reordering player entries alone did not change the Units default because the friendly group starts with towers; browser testing caught this and Units now explicitly selects the shared default.
The roster browser fixture assumed Units opened on Rotor; it now explicitly requests Rotor while a separate unqualified launch verifies MÖRK.
evidence: npm run check and npm run build passed
npm run test:browser passed, including unqualified game/Units launches, all three MÖRK bay hulls, drive/recoil/heat, and both Beam muzzle sockets and pivots
